title: Cat Cutely Puts Paws Together for Scratches When Owner Asks
description:
This cat, Bandit, had learned from a young age that putting his paws together in a cute way could get him anything he wanted. So when his owner asked him to show what he did to get scratches, Bandit sweetly put his paws together and gave a little wave.
